rationale: CTAS has gapped down sharply (~5% from prior close) on 5x relative volume, suggesting a significant catalyst (likely earnings or guidance), but with no news articles available I cannot assess whether the move is exhausted or continuing. Price is sitting at 31% of today's range near VWAP ($214.09) and the 9-EMA ($213.97), offering no clear directional edge — a bounce thesis is undermined by the lack of a defined support level, while a continuation short is risky given the stock is already well off its lows. The wide spread (17.7 bps) and uncertain post-gap dynamics make the risk/reward unattractive without a clearer setup.
